_source: audit.md §4 (验收标准 4.1 P0 / 4.2 P1). Thresholds are copied verbatim from the audit; DO NOT relax them to make a run pass.

_baseline.window: cpuL (14 windows, measured under 3 foreign headless_shell instances — absolute values are NOT a clean baseline, which is why the audit compares same-window ratios)

p0._what: mechanism verdicts — did the fix land on the target?

instances.note: every scenario, every window; >1 is FAIL

applyPerS.note: relative to the same-condition baseline, and below 5/s absolute

themeChangePerS.note: derived: removes/s divided by instance count

p1._what: CPU / frame-time verdicts, same-window comparison only

rafP50.note: SENTINEL: the baseline is 16.7 ms everywhere. p50 must NOT get worse; a worse p50 is a FAIL even if p99 improves.

reconcileRatio.note: instrument sanity, not a performance threshold

nodes.note: a >5% DOM-node difference makes the windows incomparable (INCONCLUSIVE)

p2._what: functional regression list — run WITHOUT any probe (no K-C, no K-C', no M-D)
p2.R3_system_follow: CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia prefers-color-scheme flip triggers an apply AND the attribute follows
p2.R4_wallpaper_token: body.style.getPropertyValue('--dsw-alias-bg-base') is byte-identical to the pre-fix value
p2.R5_theme_color_meta: meta[name=theme-color].content is non-empty and a legal CSS colour
p2.R6_token_override_add_remove: setting the wallpaper to none removes the token from body and the UI returns to the opaque base
p2.R7_locale: a language switch must not change colours, and must still work after the fix
p2.R8_settings_row: the Appearance row selection agrees with colorScheme / data-ds-dark-theme
p2.R9_cold_start: a reload paints the same first frame as before the fix
